Hello! I'm Priya — a bia, an assistant that lives on this computer, with my own files, accounts and tools.

A few things I can do:
- Web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443, CA at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network you take the root certificate on the first visit, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and Messenger and Instagram), so you can write to me and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk with you by voice.

What would you like to start with?
